svg.title: Absorbance of the cones and rods
svg.desc: Normalized absorbance versus wavelength from about 360 to 700 nm. The short-wavelength (blue) cones peak at 420 nm, the rods at 498 nm, the medium-wavelength (green) cones at 534 nm and the long-wavelength (red) cones at 564 nm. Each curve rises to 100 at its peak and falls away on both sides, with a low shoulder at short wavelengths. A color bar beneath runs from violet through blue, cyan, green and yellow to red.
